summary: Trident Digital Tech Holdings, a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a routine Form 6-K covering its interim period ended June 30, 2026, comprising XBRL-tagged financial data and subsequent-event disclosures. Referenced items include a September 8, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement, Class B share activity, a July 8, 2026 extraordinary general meeting concerning authorized share capital (including blank shares and Class A/B/C redesignations), and supplier/customer concentration disclosures. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, activist campaign or forced management change is disclosed. Deal terms are absent; the 6-K is an ordinary periodic report rather than a special situation.
